messages:
zoe: follow-up from the postmortem — recurring pages from batch-aggregator after the config flip last night. we sketched a few mitigations but need owners, concrete short/medium fixes, and safety guardrails so suppression doesn't hide real incidents.

rick: i'll take alert tuning. short-term: move alert from 1m instant -> 10m rolling avg and require 2 consecutive windows. will add a deploy suppression tag but only for tagged releases. PR by EOD. :thumbsup:

priya: i'll own suppression guardrails. proposal: no global suppression longer than 30m, require correlation checks (db-error, queue-latency) to bypass suppression, and an explicit runbook step that owner must acknowledge suppression. i'll draft a policy doc and open PR Tue.

laila: i'll handle dedupe & routing. plan: dedupe_key = job_name:host_pool and route to a low-priority rota during scheduled maintenance windows. also add a label `scheduled_maint=true`. testing in staging now. PR target: Thu.

ops-lead: acceptance criteria: 7-day rolling reduction in pages >= 65% for the noisy window, zero increase in user-facing errors, and at least one runbook drill showing humans can un-suppress quickly. owners must attach dashboard before/after screenshots and synthetic test results to close items.

zoe: important — suppression must surface a visible banner in the alert with an owner and expiry. don't let suppressions be silent.

rick: config snippet i'll include in the PR:
```yaml
alert: batch-aggregator-error-rate
condition: avg_over_time(10m) > 0.06
require: 2_consecutive_windows
suppression:
  when_tag: release=true
  max_duration: 30m
correlation_bypass:
  - service: db-error-rate
    threshold: 0.01
  - service: queue-latency
    threshold: 200ms
dedupe_key: "job_name:host_pool"
routing: "ops-low-priority"
```

priya: i'll add a checklist that requires the owner to post a short justification and expected expiry when creating any suppression. also add an automated pager if the suppression reaches 25m unacknowledged.

laila: staging dedupe looks good — collapsed 4 duplicates into one page. routing to low-priority rota worked in test; will post logs.

oncall-bot: incident 3076543210 resolved by zoe \u2014 duration 1h47m \u2014 postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/3076543210 (auto-note)

ops-lead: timeline recap: rick PR today, priya policy PR Tue, laila PR Thu, runbook drill scheduled in 10 days. checkpoint next_mon 09:30 to review dashboards. /remind @ops-team checkpoint next_mon 09:30

rick: PR up in ~3hrs with pre/post firing counts and synthetic that simulates config flip.

priya: policy draft pushed to WIP branch. will add the auto-pager for long suppressions.

laila: posting staging logs now and will open PR Thu.

zoe: thanks everyone — update the postmortem action list with links and screenshots. i'll verify acceptance criteria before closing items. :white_check_mark:
